final_text: Fixed two bugs in `rtl/shift_reg.v`: `load` was gated by `en` (should take priority regardless of `en`), and the right-shift inserted a constant `0` instead of `sin`. The design now matches spec.md, and the simulation reports **TEST PASSED**.
